glass_effect_id.note: SwiftUI GlassEffectContainer(spacing:20), one 150x44 capsule <-> two 60x44 (HStack spacing 30), withAnimation(.bouncy); per-frame presentation rects of the CASDFElementLayers [t since first toggle, x, y, w, h]; toggles at t=0 (split) and t=2.1163 (join)

glass_effect_union.note: GlassEffectContainer(spacing:0){HStack(spacing:30){60x44 .glassEffectUnion(id:u) x2}} renders ONE CASDFElementLayer with the bounding rect 150x44 (a capsule), smoothness 0 - a union is a single element of the members' bounds, not a smooth-min
